INSERT INTO actions (
                        id,
                        type,
                        title,
                        description,
                        duration_bucket,
                        energy_rate,
                        attention_level,
                        transition_difficulty,
                        enjoyment_after_start,
                        importance,
                        urgency_growth,
                        created_at
                    )
                    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, datetime('now'))
